description: The image models chargen_generate_image accepts, with per-image gold costs (including Low/Medium/High tiers on legacy quality-priced models and Low/Medium/High/XHigh/Max tiers on GPT Image 2.5 and 2.6), pixel size bounds and whether the model supports a reference image for image-to-image, which models are CharGen's top picks (top_pick, default_model), and how to phrase a prompt for each model family (prompt_style and prompt_styles). Costs are for one 1024x1024 image; num_images multiplies the cost. Entity generation through the fixed generation tools is free for subscribers, and so is its portrait unless the user has chosen a paid art preset in CharGen.
name: chargen_list_image_models
title: List image models
